args.message: EU261 Art 7: LH9850 FRA-TRN 24 Oct arrived 660 minutes late after the missed connection; flight over 3500 km band.
EU261 Art 9 care not given during the 9 hour wait at FRA: meal receipt DOC-R55A.
Guests arrived after midnight, 11 hours late on a Lufthansa delay; please waive the 24 Oct no-show night.

args.reason: After-hours pickup fee caused by the 11 hour flight delay.

args.text: I claimed the EU261 compensation from Lufthansa, the airline that flew you, for EUR 1200 (600 each for the 2 of you), and they approved it and will pay you by bank transfer. I also claimed your EUR 38 Frankfurt meal as care and Lufthansa accepted it. The EUR 40 Hertz after-hours fee was disputed, but Hertz upheld it, so it stands, and I left the fuel charge alone as you said. I did not claim the EUR 92 Turin airport hotel from the airline: its care covers your meal but not a hotel, since your replacement flight left Frankfurt the same day. I also did not claim the EUR 120 prepaid Turin night or the EUR 150 concert from the airline, because they are not care costs the airline pays back. I asked the Turin hotel to waive the EUR 120 night, and no waiver has been granted yet.

row.reply_text: Compensation approved. Lufthansa pays it to the passenger by bank transfer.
Receipts accepted. Lufthansa reimburses the amount claimed to the passenger by bank transfer.

grade.message: We flew Orlando to Turin on 23 October, ticket DLR55A bought as Delta but flown by Lufthansa (their record LHR55B). We missed the connection in Frankfurt, got moved 9 hours later and reached Turin after midnight, 11 hours late. We want the 600 euro EU261 compensation each. We paid 38 euros for food in Frankfurt, a 92 euro airport hotel in Turin that night, lost our prepaid Turin night (120) and a 150 euro concert, and Hertz charged us 40 euros for the after-hours pickup. Please claim all of it and dispute the Hertz fee. The fuel charge is fair, we came back with less. priya.moreau@example.com, card 3390.

args.text: I claimed the EU261 compensation from Lufthansa, the airline that flew you, for EUR 1200 (600 each for the 2 of you), and they approved it and will pay you by bank transfer. I also claimed your EUR 38 Frankfurt meal as care and Lufthansa accepted it. The EUR 40 Hertz after-hours fee was disputed, but Hertz upheld it, so it stands, and I left the fuel charge alone as you said. I did not claim the EUR 92 Turin airport hotel from the airline: its care covers your meal but not a hotel, since your replacement flight left Frankfurt the same day. I also did not claim the EUR 120 prepaid Turin night or the EUR 150 concert from the airline, because they are not care costs the airline pays back.
